author: Hoon Kim
title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator. We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: Japanese anime art style (see attached images); Experience with 2D game character art; Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors); work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Abbie Cornall
title: Hiring Colorist and Procreate Illustrator
content: A VERY EXCITING day today! It's RECRUITMENT DAY! I am looking to HIRE two positions - please message me in the DMs if you are interested! Please tag someone you know may fit the brief for these positions! I am looking for 2 freelancers.... the work will just be a few hours at first but will definitely grow more and more over time... 2) A PROCREATE ILLUSTRATOR. I require someone creative who is able to use procreate and who is able to HAND FINISH my coloring page designs for me. I can give more details of this if you would like to message me in the DMs. These will be very very simple bold and easy designs to begin with and will grow in complexity over time. If you are interested in either OR EVEN BOTH of these positions then please send me a DM and we can have a chat more specifically about what I am looking for. You will be required to send me an example of work even if you have never done this before.
